item.title: The 7 benefits of a travelling technical director
item.description: In the world of corporate events, precision and consistency are key. Engaging a dedicated Technical Director (TD) to travel with you across multiple events can streamline operations, enhance efficiency, and ensure a superior experience for attendees. Here’s why having a travelling TD is a game-changer for your events.

item.title: AV1: a certified B Corporation – for the third time!
item.description: At AV1, we believe in doing business the right way—balancing people, profit, and the planet. That’s why we’re proud to announce that we’ve been certified as a B Corporation for the third time! Since first achieving certification in 2016, we’ve remained committed to driving positive change in the events industry and beyond.
